Fed & Policy Watch

Post-FOMC repricing is the dominant policy watch after the September 15-16 meeting and September 16 press conference. The verified Fed calendar places Commercial Paper at 1:00 PM ET, H.15 at 4:15 PM, and H.4.1 at 4:30 PM today; no new statement time is inferred.

Funding-sensitive risk remains two-sided: SOFR is 3.64%, NFCI is -0.56, and MOVE is 80.73. No NYSE holiday or shortened session is listed for September 17.

Omissions and Watch

BLS omitted: the official September 2026 schedule returned HTTP 403/access denied, so CPI, PPI, employment, and labor releases are not asserted. Treasury note auctions on September 22-24 are omitted because the refreshed TreasuryDirect records did not expose verified closing times. NAR is not required for the selected dates.

BEA has no September 17 release; its verified September 24 U.S. International Transactions release is included. September 17-24 EIA, Census, TreasuryDirect, and Fed rows above have date-specific source support. MOVE 80.73 is moderate uncertainty under the stated 80-120 band; NFCI -0.56 indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions.

Trading Strategy Note - ES Futures
Base Case

ES overnight 7666.75 is modestly below the September 16 SPY close of 754.05 context. With 8:30 AM housing data, 10:30 AM gas storage, and post-FOMC repricing, use smaller defined-risk size and wait for the opening range to confirm direction. SOFR 3.64%, MOVE 80.73, and 10Y 5.01% do not signal broad funding stress.

Invalidation

A decisive ES break outside the opening range with a sharp rate or volatility repricing, or MOVE reclaiming 100, invalidates a continuation setup. Avoid chasing the first post-data move; reassess after liquidity and rates stabilize.
